versions.subject: WannaCrypt Ransomware
versions.detection:
selection1:
    EventID: 1
    Image:
        - '*\tasksche.exe'
        - '*\mssecsvc.exe'
        - '*\taskdl.exe'
        - '*\WanaDecryptor*'
        - '*\taskhsvc.exe'
        - '*\taskse.exe'
selection2:
    EventID: 1
    CommandLine:
        - '*wbadmin delete catalog -quiet*'
        - '*vssadmin delete shadows all quiet*'
        - '*cscript.exe *nologo m.vbs'
condition: selection1 or selection2
versions.spl: (EventID=1 Image IN ("*\\tasksche.exe", "*\\mssecsvc.exe", "*\\taskdl.exe", "*\\WanaDecryptor*", "*\\taskhsvc.exe", "*\\taskse.exe")) OR (EventID=1 CommandLine IN ("*wbadmin delete catalog -quiet*", "*vssadmin delete shadows all quiet*", "*cscript.exe *nologo m.vbs"))
